shared_elements: human head and torso rendered without facial detail
curved/crescent linear motif (boat hull in A; carved arcs in B)
circular disc motif (B's rings; A none strictly)
justification: Both depict the human form in a highly schematic, featureless manner — silhouetted crew figures on a boat in A versus a monumental frontal head-and-torso with carved rings and arcs on its back in B — so the only real correspondence is the generic reduction of the human body without facial detail. The scenes differ fundamentally: A is a narrative composition of two small figures standing in a crescent-hulled vessel with upturned prow and stern, while B is a single massive isolated figure whose surface bears abstract disc, arc and band motifs rather than any scene.
